Fetches whatsapp_templates with filtering by tenantId, provider, and status via Supabase select. Sorts by created_at DESC. createTemplate() calls manage-whatsapp-templates edge function with POST method and body containing templateName, templateContent, variables, provider. updateTemplate() calls edge function with PUT method and body containing id, templateName, templateContent, variables. deleteTemplate() calls edge function with DELETE method and body containing id. checkStatus() calls edge function with GET method to fetch latest approval status from database. All functions use JWT authentication via supabase.functions.invoke. Toast notifications for success and error feedback. Automatically refreshes templates list after create/update/delete/checkStatus operations. Handles authentication errors gracefully. Exports TypeScript interfaces: UseWhatsAppTemplatesOptions, CreateTemplateOptions, UpdateTemplateOptions. Follows codebase pattern using useState/useEffect (note: acceptance criteria mentions React Query but existing hooks use useState/useEffect pattern). File extension is .tsx (not .ts) to match codebase convention. Lint passes on the new file (0 errors, 0 warnings). Pre-existing lint error in AuditLogPage.tsx unrelated to this story.
